description.en: A circuit containing four resistors P, Q, R, and S, a galvanometer G, and a battery. When balanced, no current flows through the galvanometer, and P/Q = R/S.
description.hi: चार प्रतिरोधों P, Q, R, और S, एक गैल्वेनोमीटर G, और एक बैटरी वाला परिपथ। संतुलन की स्थिति में, गैल्वेनोमीटर से कोई धारा प्रवाहित नहीं होती है, और P/Q = R/S होता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 50)">
    <!-- Bridge Diamond shape -->
    <path d="M 200 50 L 300 150 L 200 250 L 100 150 Z" fill="none" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Resistor P (Top Left) -->
    <path d="M 100 150 L 130 120 L 140 130 L 160 110 L 170 120 L 200 50" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="miter" />
    <rect x="130" y="100" width="40" height="15" fill="#f8fafc" transform="rotate(-45 150 110)" />
    <path d="M 130 110 l 5 -10 l 10 20 l 10 -20 l 10 20 l 5 -10" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(-45 150 110)" />

    <!-- Resistor Q (Top Right) -->
    <rect x="230" y="100" width="40" height="15" fill="#f8fafc" transform="rotate(45 250 110)" />
    <path d="M 230 110 l 5 -10 l 10 20 l 10 -20 l 10 20 l 5 -10" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(45 250 110)" />

    <!-- Resistor R (Bottom Left) -->
    <rect x="130" y="185" width="40" height="15" fill="#f8fafc" transform="rotate(45 150 190)" />
    <path d="M 130 195 l 5 -10 l 10 20 l 10 -20 l 10 20 l 5 -10" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(45 150 190)" />

    <!-- Resistor S (Bottom Right) -->
    <rect x="230" y="185" width="40" height="15" fill="#f8fafc" transform="rotate(-45 250 190)" />
    <path d="M 230 195 l 5 -10 l 10 20 l 10 -20 l 10 20 l 5 -10" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(-45 250 190)" />

    <!-- Galvanometer -->
    <line x1="200" y1="50" x2="200" y2="115" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="200" y1="185" x2="200" y2="250" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="200" cy="150" r="35" fill="white" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="200" y="160" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle">G</text>
    <!-- Galvanometer Arrow -->
    <path d="M 200 165 L 210 135" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrowhead-red)"/>

    <!-- Battery Circuit -->
    <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="50" y2="150" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="50" y1="150" x2="50" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="50" y1="300" x2="150" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <line x1="300" y1="150" x2="350" y2="150" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="350" y1="150" x2="350" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="350" y1="300" x2="220" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Battery Symbol -->
    <line x1="150" y1="285" x2="150" y2="315" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="160" y1="295" x2="160" y2="305" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="5" />
    <line x1="160" y1="300" x2="190" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="190" y1="285" x2="190" y2="315" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="200" y1="295" x2="200" y2="305" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="5" />
    <line x1="200" y1="300" x2="220" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2" />

    <text x="145" y="280" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151">+</text>
    <text x="210" y="280" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151">-</text>
    <text x="175" y="330" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">E</text>

    <!-- Labels P, Q, R, S -->
    <text x="120" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">P</text>
    <text x="270" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">Q</text>
    <text x="120" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">R</text>
    <text x="270" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">S</text>

    <!-- Node Points -->
    <circle cx="100" cy="150" r="4" fill="#374151" />
    <circle cx="300" cy="150" r="4" fill="#374151" />
    <circle cx="200" cy="50" r="4" fill="#374151" />
    <circle cx="200" cy="250" r="4" fill="#374151" />

    <text x="200" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
    <text x="200" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">D</text>
    <text x="80" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
    <text x="320" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
  </g>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead-red" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#ef4444" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
